offering_description.value: Copart runs online auctions for salvage and used vehicles from insurers, dealers, fleets and individuals, and sells some vehicles from its own inventory. It collects and stores vehicles at its yards for purchase by dismantlers, rebuilders, dealers, exporters and individual buyers. It also auctions powersports vehicles and heavy equipment.

primary_products.value: Salvage vehicles and used vehicles sold from company-owned inventory

primary_services.value: Online vehicle and equipment auctions; vehicle towing and transport; vehicle storage; title processing

customer_segment.value: B2B: Insurers, dealers, rental and fleet operators, dismantlers, rebuilders, exporters and heavy equipment businesses; B2C: Individuals selling or bidding on vehicles; B2G: Government agencies and municipalities selling surplus or impounded vehicles

end_markets.value: Auto insurance; automotive recycling and repair; used vehicle trade; powersports; construction and agricultural equipment

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: Buyer and seller fees on auction transactions; product sales: Salvage and used vehicles sold from company-owned inventory; service fees: Vehicle towing, storage and title processing; subscription: Annual memberships for auction buyers
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; product sales; service fees; subscription

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: Lists vehicles and equipment from consignors for dealers, dismantlers, exporters, businesses and individual buyers; service provider: Collects and processes vehicles for insurers, fleets and other sellers; asset operator: Runs vehicle yards that receive inventory from sellers and release it to auction buyers
value_chain_position.category: software / platform; service provider; asset operator

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, Brazil, United Kingdom, continental Europe and the Middle East

specialization.value: related lines: Salvage and used vehicle auctions, powersports and heavy equipment auctions, and vehicle logistics

distribution_channels.value: online: Company auction websites and mobile apps; direct sales: Direct remarketing relationships with insurers, dealers and fleet operators; own locations: Company yards for vehicle inspection and pickup

regulatory_exposure.value: high: State motor vehicle and auction licensing where required, plus salvage title and environmental rules for vehicle yards
